about: The fields of every JSON output of the stable C ABI (core/include/iai_actuator_driver.h), sampled on the native simulator by bindings/python/tests/test_abi_json_keys.py; within an ABI major a field is only added, never removed, renamed or retyped. Regenerate with: python tests/test_abi_json_keys.py --update (from bindings/python). "requests": the keys the parser of each JSON request of the header reads (a string: the output the document is), kept by hand and checked against the parsers by tests/test_abi_request_keys.py.
